name: frappe-errors-clientscripts
description: Use when debugging or preventing errors in Frappe Client Scripts. Prevents TypeError, frappe.call failures, async/await mistakes, cur_frm vs frm confusion, field not found, child table access errors, timing issues, CSRF token errors, and permission denied on frappe.call. Covers error diagnosis flowchart and debug tools for v14/v15/v16. Keywords: client script error, TypeError, frappe.call, async await,, Cannot read properties of undefined, TypeError, browser console error, script not running, form not updating. cur_frm, field not found, child table, CSRF, permission denied.
